patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Tiendanube and Webflow share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Tiendanube and Webflow share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than Webflow's shape. Choose Webflow only if your buying job matches “Design-led website platform with Ecommerce — Standard $29/mo (500 items, 2% fee), Plus $74” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Workflow advantage: Tiendanube leans shared coverage; Webflow leans website-builder-commerce. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Tiendanube and Webflow share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala ; Webflow is Design-led website platform with Ecommerce — Standard $29/mo (500 items, 2% fee), Plus $74 highlighted (5,000 items, 0% fee), Advanced $212 .
- Company-size focus: Tiendanube (small-business, mid-market) vs Webflow (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Tiendanube-leaning — vs Webflow-leaning website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; Webflow — Ecommerce requires a Site plan in addition to the Ecommerce plan — model combined TCO, not the $29 floor alone.

Limitations — Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth; Webflow: Ecommerce requires a Site plan in addition to the Ecommerce plan — model combined TCO, not the $29 floor alone; Catalog caps (500 / 5,000 / 15,000 items) and Standard’s 2% transaction fee trail Shopify-class commerce OS depth.

Poor-fit cases: Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Webflow is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Ecommerce requires a Site plan in addition to the Ecommerce plan — model combined TCO, not the $29 floor alone · Avoid Tiendanube if you actually need Webflow's motion (Design-led website platform with Ecommerce — Standard $29/mo (500 items, 2% fee))

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
